title: Vanishing on a cover implies vanishing on every basis open
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D and coefficient datum c [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a locally finite-type k0-scheme T, and K in the literal cartesian local heart [def-dl-a1-locally-constructible-adic-heart]. Let I be any indexing type and U_i separated finite-type opens with supremum T. If every component K_(U_i) is a zero object in its common-stage standard heart [def-weil-constructible-heart], then K_V is a zero object for every separated finite-type basis open V. No global Abelian structure on the cartesian category, finite cover, or common coefficient field on T is assumed.

source.place: §6.8, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; local cartesian heart defects on finite-type affine opens (returned proof Step 12). Stacks Tag 04TQ, sites-lemma-glue-maps.

proof.text: Assume $K_{U_i}=0$ for all covering members. Fix a basis open $V$ and any geometric point $\bar v:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$. Choose $i$ with its underlying point in $U_i$, and then a basis open $W$ containing that point and contained in $V\cap U_i$. The basis property is stated in [def-dl-a1-locally-constructible-adic-heart]. The cartesian comparison identifies $K_W$ with $r_{W,U_i}K_{U_i}=0$. The geometric point factors through $W$; the pullback-fibre comparison of [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres] identifies its fibre on $K_V$ with that on $K_W$, hence with zero. The joint conservativity of those fibres on $\mathcal H_V$ gives $K_V=0$. This proves the asserted vanishing on each basis open. No global abelian structure or defect computation is used.

theorem dlLocalHeartCoverBasisZero [LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom]
    (I : Type w) (U : I → DlAdicFiniteOpen D T) (hU : (⨆ i : I, (U i).val) = ⊤)
    (K : DlLocallyConstructibleAdicHeart D c T)
    (hK : ∀ i : I, IsZero ((dlAdicLocalEvaluation D c T (U i)).obj K)) :
    ∀ V : DlAdicFiniteOpen D T, IsZero ((dlAdicLocalEvaluation D c T V).obj K)
